Two PRs ship together as 9.1.0. **PR A** (Phases 1–3) is the ledger, the board and the eval seam. **PR B** (Phases 4–6)
is deploy: recipes, trains, the lane merge and placement, and it is the trust-bearing PR. Most tasks own
`hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh`, `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh` or `tests/smoke-lifecycle.sh`, so few can run in parallel.

## Phase 6: User Stories (PR B)
### P1 — Must Have
- [x] T020 [US7] [FR-014] [FR-017] [FR-018] [NR-003] `recipe_scope` + `request <OP-n> --recipe <env> --version <v> [--sha <s>]` (a recipe hangs on an op, note 9). Placeholders are `{version}`, `{sha}` and `{env}` only, and an unknown one is refused, naming it; also refused: an unknown env (listing the configured ones), an empty step, a scope-check rejection. `action step` compares `expects[n]` against the evidence file and auto-stops on a mismatch with both values. Test NR-003: editing the recipe after `approve` changes nothing; the new command is denied. `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh`
- [x] T021 [US9] [FR-020] [FR-021] [FR-022] [FR-023] [NR-004] `merge_scope` + `request <id> --merge`: the head pinned through `gh_bin`; step 1 = `pr-watch.sh state`; checks with `{repo_path}`/`{base}` substituted (note 16) and `after_step: 1`; the merge `gh pr merge <n> -R <owner/repo> --merge --match-head-commit <sha>` with `after_step` = the last check. Exclusivity is keyed on every `heads` owner/repo across approved/taken merge **and** train actions, at request **and** at approve. `action take`/`heads` fetch in the repo (note 10). `action stop --step <n> --block conflict` replaces `human:merge` with `conflict`. `done` fetches, runs `merge_evidence` with the PR's merge commit from `gh_pr_fact` (note 4), stamps, clears `human:merge` and advances to `merged`, refused without evidence. Risks row on what is mechanical (note 11): the state step records only `mergeable` if `action step` can run `pr-watch.sh state` itself within the part's size; otherwise the row says it is the lane's report. Tests: a moved head stops before the merge; the merge is denied before step 1 is recorded; a second merge action on one repo is refused at request and at approve. `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh`
- [x] T022 [US8] [FR-019] `train_scope` + `request <OP-n> --train <name> --env <env> --pr <repo>=<n> …`: per repo in order, a state step, checks (`-C {repo_path}`, `{base}` through `branches --repo`) and the merge, each gated by `after_step`; a missing PR or a repo not in the board is refused. `done`: per head, in its repo (fetch), `pr_merge_evidence` (MERGED, head == pinned, merge commit in the PR's **base**); it fails closed without gh (note 19), and no item phase moves. Tests: a promotion PR with base `stg` passes when its merge commit is in `stg` and fails when it is only in `main`; the second repo's merge is denied until the first repo's steps are recorded; a train plus a merge action on one repo is refused. `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh`
- [x] T023 [US9] [FR-020] [FR-024] `commands/hef.orchestrate.md`: the `human:merge` row by `merge_by` (`person` unchanged; `lane` drafts first, the form shows `action show`, **Merge** → `approve`, a pending draft whose head still matches is reused and otherwise superseded, note 6); forms for drop/fold/supersede/reopen, a recipe run and a train; the deployer's procedure for merge/recipe/train actions, `deployed`, and `action stop --block conflict` → the Retry form (`:140`). `commands/hef.orchestrate.md`
